data.content_ref: inline:The relation is an abstraction: 3e200f5e7e7e abstracts over the RESIDUE and standing-residue annotations by compressing the post-fixpoint explanation of an undecided node into three classes (direct_attack, mutual_attack, insufficient_defense), while RESIDUE records the specific attacker and the standing report records structural isolation from accepted defenders; all three are pure functions of the same final grounded labels and graph. Refuted if any undecided node can receive different suspend_reason classes under identical final labels and graph, or if RESIDUE names an attacker for a node whose suspend_reason is insufficient_defense, or if a standing node (no defender within k) is classified direct_attack.
